title: Common finite coefficients for compatible local embeddings
statement: Use the finite coefficient fields [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], internal-module convention [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], and pro-etale covers [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]. Let f:X→T with X quasi-separated, ℓ prime, M an internal f⁻¹Ω_T-module, and E a finite coefficient subfield. Let U_i→X be a finite affine pro-etale cover and N_i finitely presented modules over the restrictions of f⁻¹E_T, with Ω-extension isomorphic to M|Ui. Then some finite F≥E has monomorphisms q_i from F⊗E N_i into (Res_FΩ M)|Ui. Their scalar adjoints to M|Ui are isomorphisms. On each Ui×XUj their underlying abelian-sheaf domains are isomorphic by c_ij, commuting with the q_i and the specified upperStarCompIso into the pullback of Res_FΩ M. This is only local embedding/overlap data: no global finite-coefficient module is asserted.

source.place: (Obj) descent paragraph, finite-stage comparisons on pairwise overlaps

proof.text: Choose the supplied local isomorphisms. At every finite stage construct their canonical scalar adjoints by the explicit local coefficient API. The projection-retraction proof makes them monic, and their scalar adjuncts are isomorphisms.

Pairwise overlaps are qcqs because X is quasi-separated and the covering schemes are affine. Use the finite family of ordered pairs, in both directions. Apply pairwise Hom descent to obtain a common F and both maps commuting with the canonical adjoints.

The reverse upperStarCompIso is the inverse of the forward one. Compose the two comparison equations and cancel the pulled monomorphisms into the ambient restricted module. Both composites are identities, so the two maps define the required underlying overlap isomorphism. Its compatibility is exactly the forward equation. The scalar-adjoint condition follows from the explicit transitivity computation. The empty cover is included in the finite-family theorem.

theorem exists_finiteCoefficient_compatible_local_monomorphisms
    (T X : Scheme.{u}) [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (f : X ⟶ T) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ)))
    (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ))
    (U : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X)
    (hfinite : Finite U.I₀) (haffine : ∀ i, IsAffine (U.X i))
    (N : ∀ i, Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (U.X i)) Ab.{u + 1})
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))))
    (hN : ∀ i, Mod.IsFinitelyPresented
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).obj
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ E))) (N i))
    (e : ∀ i, Nonempty ((Mod.extendScalars
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).map
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ E)))).obj
          (N i) ≅
      ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).mapMod
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ))).obj M)) :
    ∃ (F : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields ℓ (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) (hEF : E ≤ F),
      let R := (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicSubfieldRingObj T ℓ F)
      let S := (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).obj (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ)
      let a := (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl T ℓ F)
      let L := fun i ↦ (Mod.extendScalars ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).map
        ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (padicSubfieldRingObjMap T ℓ hEF)))).obj (N i)
      ∃ q : ∀ i, L i ⟶ ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).mapMod R).obj
        ((Mod.comap a).obj M),
        (∀ i, Mono (q i)) ∧
        (∀ i, IsIso (((Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction
          ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).map a)).homEquiv (L i)
            (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).mapMod S).obj M)).symm
              (q i ≫ ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (U.f i)).mapModComapIso a).hom.app M))) ∧
        (∀ i j, ∃ c :
          (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (U.f i) (U.f j))).obj (L i).X ≅
            (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (U.f i) (U.f j))).obj (L j).X,
          c.hom ≫ (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.snd (U.f i) (U.f j))).map (q j).hom =
            (upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (pullback.fst (U.f i) (U.f j))).map (q i).hom ≫
              (upperStarCompIso Ab.{u + 1}
                (pullback.condition (f := U.f i) (g := U.f j))).hom.app
                  ((Mod.comap a).obj M).X)
